project.name: site-conselho-tutelar
project.description: Prototipo academico de site institucional informativo sobre Conselho Tutelar para orientar familias e responsaveis, desenvolvido junto ao CRAS e pensado para posterior replicacao em WordPress.

architecture.pattern: Static multipage website with shared assets

standards.languageConventions: Semantic HTML, reusable CSS classes, minimal JavaScript, kebab-case file names, Portuguese content with clear and welcoming tone.
standards.formatting: Manual consistent indentation and readable HTML/CSS organization.
standards.testing: Manual browser validation for navigation, links, responsive layout, basic accessibility, and placeholder review.
standards.notes: Keep the prototype simple and easy to reproduce as WordPress pages/blocks. Do not invent official contact data; use placeholders until CRAS/municipality confirms details.
